description: An HTML file that serves as the user interface for a Database Viewer application, featuring styles for layout, interaction, and display of database tables.

methods.name: showLoading
methods.description: Displays a loading message within a specified HTML element.

methods.name: showError
methods.description: Displays an error message within a specified HTML element.

methods.name: showEmptyState
methods.description: Shows an empty state message in a given element.

methods.name: setActiveState
methods.description: Sets the active state for a specified element and removes it from other elements.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches and displays the list of databases.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the list of databases and updates the UI.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Toggles the view of tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches and displays the list of tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches and displays data from a selected table in a database.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Renders the given data into a structured HTML table format.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Creates HTML for a cell in the table based on the provided value.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands a cell to show its full content when clicked.
